coverage: Selective Bucharest launch from seven verified cultural venues: concerts, opera, theatre, family workshops, talks and temporary exhibitions.53actual sessions and4ranges; visiting windows are not performances. Primary organizer and ticket bodies were checked with unknown costs, tax conditions, ages, consent and room restrictions retained. Citywide catalogue coverage remains partial, east/south neighbourhoods and sport are weak, and not every date has a timed event. Four unverified presale minima are kept only as conditional notes; two doors/show corrections use actual21:00. A same-host stop error led to six post-denial MuzeulViu reads; all six and their derived facts are quarantined and excluded. Telegram unavailable, zero imports.
description: Sourced venue selection. A directory entry does not confirm opening today; check the venue before visiting.
